title: Retained schema success and unexpected-defect boundaries
question: Does optional diagnostic publication preserve a successful actual schema check, and does an unexpected retained schema group use distinct exception custody?
method: Invoke actual schema check through Typer in temporary managed stores. Compare ordinary retained success with a controlled publication OSError. Inject an ExceptionGroup at actual preparation, preserve its identity, and read the retained diagnostic through the CLI. Product source is 0da4f8e614b162b791ac19dcb63f6cd33178377b; only evidence/documentation changes accompany this audit.

outputs.role: observed product outcomes and independent contract checks

conclusion: The positive control succeeds, but both accepted route contracts fail: optional publication replaces successful check outcome/result, and unexpected grouped defects retain boundary validation without typed exception observations. This establishes current CA01/02 behavior, not a full future group/chain/frame acceptance test. No production or test repair was made.
